name: Beast Speaker (Mythic)
body:
Even savage beasts willingly serve you if trained and well treated.

Prerequisite(s): Beast Speaker

Benefit(s): You are considered one level higher for all purposes related to the class feature that grants you a mount or companion. Your beast companion is considered a mythic creature and gains the hard to kill base mythic ability.

Whenever you expend a mythic surge your beast companion also gains a mythic surge that it can use at any time before the beginning of your next turn.

Special: You can select the mythic companion 1st-tier path ability, regardless of your path.
